chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from some of his companions, from al-Washa', from Ali ibn Abi Hamza who said:

Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Verily, the ark of Noah was commanded; it circumambulated the House (Kaaba) when the land was drowned. Then it came to Mina during its [appointed] days, then the ark returned. It was commanded, and it circumambulated the House with the circumambulation of the women (Tawaf al-Nisa').'

key_terms.سَفِينَة نُوح: The Ark of Noah — here presented as a spiritually active vessel performing sacred rites
key_terms.طَوَاف: Ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba — one of the central rites of Hajj
key_terms.طَوَاف النِّسَاء: Tawaf al-Nisa' — the final circumambulation performed in Hajj, specific to Shia jurisprudence, without which spousal relations are not restored
key_terms.مَأْمُورَة: Commanded by divine order — passive participle indicating the Ark acted under direct divine instruction
key_terms.مِنَى: Mina — the valley near Mecca where pilgrims spend days during Hajj for symbolic acts

ai.seo_question: Did Noah's Ark perform Hajj and circumambulate the Kaaba during the Great Flood?
ai.summary: The Imam (peace be upon him) describes a remarkable cosmological tradition: that during the Great Flood, the Ark of Prophet Noah (peace be upon him) was divinely commanded to perform the rites of Hajj — circumambulating the submerged Kaaba and visiting Mina — completing even the Tawaf al-Nisa', the final circumambulation ritual. This narration establishes the sanctity of the Kaaba and the Hajj rites as primordial divine institutions predating the Flood, showing that these sacred obligations were honored even in the most cataclysmic of times. The audience — Shia Muslims in a period when the Imam's cosmological knowledge was prized — would understand this as evidence that the Kaaba's sanctity transcends all earthly catastrophes.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from one of his companions, from Al Washa, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza who said,

‘Abu Al-Hassanasws said to me: ‘The ark of Noahas was Commanded to circumambulate the House (Kaaba) when the land was drowned. Then it came to Mina during its days, and then the ark returned. It was Commanded to circumambulate with the House, a circumambulation of the women (Tawaaf Al-Nisa)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from certain individuals of his people from al-Washsha’ from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following:

“Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘Noah’s Ark was commanded to perform Tawaf around the House as the land was submerged in water; then it went to Mina during its days, then it returned back and it was commanded to perform Tawaf around the House in the form of Tawaf of women.’”
